title: Wave 0: immediate trust fixes (roadmap 2026-09-10)
description: Bounded defects from the 2026-09-10 improvement roadmap (Downloads/Moes-Tavern-Improvement-Roadmap.md), each verified against main c0a94af. Goal: the controls and numbers shown in the IDE correspond to actual runtime behaviour. Wave 1 (durable attempt + frozen candidate + delivery receipt) is a separate epic and depends on nothing here.
architectureNotes: JetBrains is the primary IDE: implement and test Kotlin changes first, VS Code parity second. Daemon is the sole writer of .moe runtime state. Every task here is 1-3 files per client and must ship with a regression test (vitest for daemon, JUnit 4 for the plugin).
epicRails: Do not widen scope into Wave 1 (attempt/candidate/receipt) work — file it as a separate epic.
Ship JetBrains first; VS Code follows in the same task only if trivial, otherwise a follow-up card.
Every fix lands with a test that fails on the old behaviour.
